flags.label: Chain ends at undisclosed donors
flags.detail: 53% of FOR OUR FUTURE's receipts stop at organizations whose own funding is not on file (advocacy nonprofits, LLCs, trusts) rather than at named individuals, businesses or unions.

issue_focus.description: For Our Future 'builds progressive power through voter engagement, issue advocacy, and community organizing to create shared economic prosperity, strengthen public education, and advance social and racial justice.' Its issues page leads with costs of housing, healthcare, childcare and groceries. Public education and racial justice have no frozen id.

basis.rule: Self-described focus from the organisation's own material; says what the org is for, not what its dollars bought
